sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm meeting my sister for lunch on her birthday.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Her gift's in a paper bag, and it's pouring outside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I buy an umbrella at the station shop before leaving.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here's your receipt, and there's a door to the street there.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll open it just outside the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Under the roof outside, I press the button on the handle.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The umbrella opens halfway and stops.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I take it back to the counter.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Excuse me, I just bought this, and it won't open properly.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Oh, let me try it under the roof.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yeah, the button's stuck.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I swap it for another one?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, have you still got your receipt?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Here you go, I paid by card a minute ago.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Thanks, let me check what we've got left.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We're out of the small ones, but you can take a bigger one today.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which size have you still got?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just the big ones.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That's fine if it's the same price.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It is, and you'll have more room under it too.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Good, I need to keep this bag dry.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I'll get one from the back for you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He brings out a blue one and hands it to me.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I try it under the roof before I go?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll hold your bag while you try it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I step out with the new umbrella and press the button.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: There we go, this one opens all the way.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, I'll take back the faulty one.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here's your bag, and keep the receipt for the new one.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks for sorting that out so quickly.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I walk to the café with the bag under my umbrella.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My sister pulls her gift out of the dry bag.
